test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 8% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (₹2500 × 8 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹400

**The simple interest on ₹2500 at an 8% per year rate of interest for 2 years is ₹400.**
